That was a MEASUREMENT fix, not 278 fixes - the gate had been reading only the route DEFINITION line, while the triage tool already reported those routes as guarded, and that disagreement is what exposed the bug. Second: 16 -> 0 on 2026-10-01, when the 16 remaining routes were each reviewed and given a real decision - six were genuine gaps (PUT /api/facilities/settings had NO role guard on a write; GET /api/clinic/staff FAILED OPEN for a tenant-less account and returned every facility-less staff account on the platform; GET /api/lab/outbreak exposed cross-tenant abnormal-result geography; GET /api/beds/heatmap exposed platform-wide bed capacity; GET /api/appointments/booked-slots exposed another tenant's booking volume; POST /api/delivery/optimize-route was an ungated routing oracle with no stop cap) and nine were self-service that was correct but unrecorded. A baseline is a floor, so 0 means any new unclassified route now fails immediately.
